title: BEST 1.21 BONEMEAL FARM in Minecraft Bedrock! (Windows10/MCPE/NintendoSwitch/PS4/Xbox)
description:
In this video, I will show you how to build the next generation of bonemeal farming based on kelp farming, it uses just a few redstone dusts and redstone torches without using any repeater or comparator and it works same speed as hyper modules in Minecraft!

If you enjoy this channel will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
